item.title: 【UPSCALED】Avril Lavigne - My Happy Ending (versions in 8K, 4K and 1080p with ALAC uncensored audio)
item.description:
ALL SCREENSHOTS ARE FROM THE 8K VERSION.



















Notes: Uncensored audio. This was shot in 23.976 fps. I made the 8K upscale first and then downgraded it to the "lesser" resolutions.

Source: MPG 512i master + Audio from the master itself + a little bit from the RCDA to cover the censor (audio from the master was mostly bettter, so...).

Codec #1: 4320p (8K) HEVC video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container (Uncensored)
Codec #2: 2160p (4K) HEVC video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container (Uncensored)
Codec #3: 1080p (Full HD) H264 video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container (Uncensored)
